title: Oak Island Money Pit Secrets

scenes.text: What 90‑foot shaft hides a centuries‑old treasure?
The pit sits on Oak Island in Nova Scotia’s Halifax County, Canada.
Excavations have uncovered more than 20 layers of wooden platforms.
Early 20th‑century newsreels show the original trench being dug.
scenes.archive_query: Oak Island Money Pit 1900 newsreel footage

scenes.text: Despite countless digs, no definitive treasure has been verified.
scenes.label: NO CONFIRMED FIND
scenes.sub: All artifacts so far are mundane tools.
scenes.query: old rusted metal tools in soil

scenes.text: Follow for a new mystery every day.

description: For over two centuries treasure hunters have chased a deep pit on Oak Island, uncovering layers of wood but no clear loot. See what the evidence really shows.
